Tesla Roadster 2020 visual model by metarex.4d.
Original: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/tesla-roadster-2020-1fbf29e297bd4a17ac39a00a378441d8
License: CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Author: https://sketchfab.com/metarex.4d
Retrieved from licensed public redistribution https://github.com/AbduSalam08/3dModel-Tesla-Roadster
Original license matches live Sketchfab public API metadata.
Model year designation is the artist title, a 2017-announced Roadster concept commonly called 2020.
NOT the 2026 Rocket design. NOT Tesla official CAD or verified engineering geometry.
Geometry and materials copied without modification. Runtime transforms, wheel animation, paint changes, and educational added thrusters are adaptations by Roadster Flight Lab.
Original physical dimensions, mass, inertia, and aerodynamic data are NOT validated by this visual asset.
Largest payload is scene.bin (22,263,040 bytes), under 25 MiB. All 9 texture dependencies are included.

exterior-indices.bin is a display adaptation by Roadster Flight Lab, distributed under the same CC BY 4.0 license.
The assembled exterior uses 48,592 triangles. The original 608,850 triangles remain available for inspection and close views.
The adaptation reuses all 105 selectable meshes and their original vertices, normals, UV coordinates, and materials.
Rebuild from the repository root with Node.js: npm install --no-save --package-lock=false meshoptimizer@1.0.1
Then run: node scripts/build-roadster-display-lod.mjs
The simplifier enforces fixed mesh boundaries, weights normals and UVs, targets 6.5% of the source index count with a 0.008 relative attribute-aware error limit,
and keeps small meshes intact. The browser reads the prepared index file and does not require meshoptimizer.
